author: Arcani test fixtures
rationale: Stored-gain fixture (Story 4.2): theta-cycle-sine.json with its loudness gain and loudness hash stored by arcani-render --store-gain on the dev PC at 48 kHz, never re-stored in CI. The final-mode loudness checks render it as committed, so an engine change that moves the level fails them. Theta reference: a 450 Hz carrier amplitude-modulated by the sine envelope at a theta rate that cycles over 1 to 6 Hz every 60 s, 75 percent AM depth, 120 s. Values are placeholders, not starter defaults. A test fixture, not for listening.
